Under the completed dependence-safe original-coordinate outer-square hypothesis with coefficient a!=0, the same exact-rank-two bank yields ||p_Q||_infinity <= (2^(4/3)+1)sqrt(3)2^(1/4)|a|^(-1/2)Delta_jr^(-1/8).

Applying account03/B08 r20's factorized exterior-bank lower bound gives ||p_Q||_infinity < 7.711210/sqrt(|a| gamma) in its exact-rank-two residual branch, improving the prior <10.575 endpoint without single-minor selection.

In the strictly higher-rank account03/B08 r20 branch, the top-two SVD truncation H2 has Delta_jr(H2)>0.610403497 gamma^4, so the auxiliary form with H replaced by H2 has the grouped L3 and outer-square bounds <2.845475 gamma^(-2/3) and <7.711506/sqrt(|a|gamma), respectively. No bound for the original higher-rank form is inferred by discarding its tail.
